title: Conflicting accounts of who sent Puharich to Israel (foundation vs CIA)

tellings.quote: And then Geller himself said, oh, yeah, no, he he was sent by the CIA, like directly.

plain: Around 1970 and 1971, Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic powers, went to Tel Aviv in Israel to meet Uri Geller, a performer famous for claiming to bend spoons with his mind, and there are two stories of who sent him. The researcher Greg Malatzi says Puharich's own lectures name a foundation as the sender, but that Geller later said, "he was sent by the CIA, like directly." If Geller's version is right, the US spy agency was behind one of the best-known psychic investigations of the time.
